packages.label: מ"ט שַׁעֲרֵי תְּשׁוּבָה
packages.reason: These three nodes are all different expressions of the same structural unit: the forty-nine-fold pathway through which teshuva unfolds. The forty-nine gates of teshuva ARE the forty-nine letters of the names of the twelve tribes (each gate has its corresponding tribal letter), and the forty-nine days of Sefirat HaOmer ARE those same gates. They are three faces of the same forty-nine-chambered reality — the human-accessible dimension of repentance.
nodes: מ"ט אותיות שיש בשמות שנים־עשר שבטי י־ה

packages.label: שַׁעַר הַחֲמִשִּׁים וְתְּשׁוּבַת הַשֵּׁם
packages.label_en: The Fiftieth Gate and God's Own Repentance
packages.reason: These three nodes express the transcendent level of teshuva that is beyond any individual human's direct attainment: the fiftieth gate, the fiftieth day (Matan Torah / the descent of God onto Sinai), and the 'repentance of God Himself' (va'ashuva aleichem). They are identical: the fifty-day culmination of the Omer, the revelation at Sinai, and the divine 'return' to Israel are three descriptions of the same supernal, transcendent dimension of repentance.

packages.label: מִצְרַיִם וּתְשׁוּבָה עִלָּאָה
packages.label_en: Egypt as Supernal Repentance — The Narrow Throat
packages.reason: These three nodes are all expressions of the mystical concept of the supernal / upper teshuva (teshuvah ilaah), rooted in the Ari's teaching. Egypt (Mitzrayim) IS the narrowing of the throat (metzar ha-garon) — the word Mitzrayim shares its root with metzar (constriction). The throat is the organ of speech and swallowing — both physiologically and spiritually, the site of constriction and refinement that purifies what passes through it. And this site of constriction IS teshuvah ilaah — the supernal, upper-dimension repentance that the Ari identifies with binah. The three nodes are one mystical identity: the place, its physical analogue, and its spiritual level.
